## 3dslibris 2.9.1

This update makes the menus easier to use without a touchscreen and fixes EPUB layout, navigation, and RTF text issues.

### Improvements

* #156: navigate settings and the go-to-page dialog with the D-pad as well as the Circle Pad. The D-pad also changes pages in book information.
* Make the selected option easier to see in settings, font selection, the index, and bookmarks across the available color modes.
* Improved test quality and coverage.

### Bug Fixes

* #139: keep text after a horizontal rule near the page edge instead of dropping the following heading.
* #142: place adjacent block divisions on separate lines.
* Keep distinct EPUB index entries when their anchors share a page, including after malformed XHTML.
* Read RTF control words starting with `u` without mistaking them for Unicode characters.
* Stop cancelled book openings before parsing starts, including TXT files.
